cases.name: Ecuador 24-Bus National Planning Case
cases.description: National long-term expansion-planning application of PARAMO using a 24-bus equivalent of the Ecuadorian power system.
cases.public_scope_note: The public 24-bus distribution reports transmission investment at aggregate level; corridor-level optimized build/reconductoring and line-flow variables are outside the public dataset.

cases.name: Ecuador 6-Bus Reduced Planning Case
cases.description: Reduced Ecuador planning case executed with the PARAMO formulation and calibrated hydrology.
cases.public_scope_note: The public distribution includes corridor utilization, new circuits and transmission CAPEX.
cases.zone_code_convention: Canonical public zone codes with original model codes retained as traceability fields.
